page.layout: One printed page, single text column with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head centred at top, page number at top right. Below the text, a signature at bottom left and a catchword at bottom right. Fragments of the neighbouring page at the left edge are not transcribed.

main_text.head: Explicat.
main_text.p: Per antiquam intelligimus res illorum Imperiorum, quorum memoria & nomen penitùs extinctum est, ut: Assyriorum Lacedæmoniorum, &c. Per Novam, illa, quæ hodie per universum orbem florent, Imperia.
Antiqua est vel Asiatica, Africana, Europæa.
Asiatica est vel Babylonica, Persica, Scythica, Indica.
main_text.head: IMPERIUM BABY-LONICUM.
main_text.p: Imperium Babylonicum {t}à Chaldæis ad Arabes, ab hisad Assyrios pervenit.

page.notes: Marginal notes, right side, as printed: "quæ ve" (beside first line), "An tiqv" (beside "memoria"), "vel No-va." (beside "hodie"), "Antiqua versatus[?] circa Imperia." (beside "Antiqua est"), "Asiati-ca, & q videm" (beside "Asiatica est"), "(t) Ba-byloni-cum," (beside "Imperium Babylonicum"). The note marked "{t}" is placed at the reference in the text; the mark in the text itself is faint and uncertain. "versatus" is uncertain; the first line of the note is cut short in print. The "5" of "Canon 5" is a stylised figure and is uncertain. "Imperium Babylonicum" is printed in italic only for the word "Babylonicum". The heading "IMPERIUM BABY-LONICUM." keeps the printed hyphen. Left edge: fragments of the neighbouring page, not transcribed.
